The topology mask shows some fragmentation/incompleteness (missing parts of the pile), suggesting minor boundary issues or segmentation failure due to low contrast/fusion, which aligns with the Router's 'texture_anomaly' observation. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no noise/blur, which is good, but it misses the semantic artifact of bad text.
